sql.permission.getUserPermissions: select p.permission_name from flow.user_role ur inner join flow.role r on r.id = ur.role_id inner join flow.role_permission rp on rp.role_id = r.id inner join flow.permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where ur.user_id = :userId AND r.archived is not true and p.archived is not true group by p.permission_name
sql.permission.getAllForCompany: select p.id, p.permission_name, p.archived, p.permission_code from flow.permission p where p.company_id = :companyId and p.archived is not true order by p.permission_name
sql.permission.getOne: select p.id, p.permission_name, p.archived, p.permission_code from flow.permission p where p.id = :id
sql.permission.updatePermission: update flow.permission set permission_name = :permissionName, permission_code = :permissionCode where id = :id
sql.permission.insertPermission: insert into flow.permission (company_id, permission_name, permission_code) values (:companyId, :permissionName, :permissionCode)
